content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment processors impose heavy fees and restrictions that can stifle digital creators. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can substantially cut into your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments only charges a minimal 0.5% fee, allowing you to keep more of your revenue. This infrastructure is designed to empower creators by providing them with complete ownership of their sales process, free from the constraints and uncertainties of conventional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components. First, choose your hosting solution, like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are both free. Next, set up your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, both of which offer powerful automation capabilities. Ensure you have a reliable storage solution for orders, such as Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, prepare your digital products for delivery using services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once you have these in place, you’re ready to proceed.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Configuring your payment and delivery system is crucial for a seamless customer experience. Start by integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This setup allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with instant on-chain verification. Then, create automated delivery mechanisms using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to ensure that customers receive their products immediately upon successful payment. This streamlined process not only enhances efficiency but also improves customer satisfaction, as they receive their purchases without delay.
NOWPayments makes crypto transactions seamless with a mere 0.5% fee.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Begin by testing your setup with a few transactions to ensure everything functions correctly. Make sure your payment processor is working seamlessly and that customers can access their products immediately. After validating that your system is operational, start promoting your digital products on social media and other channels to attract buyers. Monitor your sales and customer interactions closely to address any issues that may arise promptly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider scaling your operations. You can add more products to your catalog and utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for expansion. Implement marketing strategies to reach a broader audience and analyze customer behavior to optimize your offerings. With a robust infrastructure, you can confidently grow your business without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack that utilizes crypto payments. This infrastructure allows you to retain full control over your sales process and eliminates high fees associated with traditional platforms. By using solutions like NOWPayments for payment processing, you can maximize your profits and streamline product delivery.
You own your entire digital commerce setup, with no hidden fees or subscriptions.

If you are looking to sell digital products like templates and fonts without relying on restrictive platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit equips you with everything needed to deploy your own digital commerce stack, ensuring sovereignty in your operations. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Absolutely. With this infrastructure, you maintain full ownership of your data after deployment. There are no platform intermediaries that can access or control your customer information.
